conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Why’s there a ₹500 penalty on my account? I didn’t do anything wrong!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the confusion Sir. Can you share your account number to investigate?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s three two one, nine eight seven, six five, four eight. This is my savings, not some loan!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I see a cheque bounce fee due to insufficient funds. I can waive it as a one-time gesture.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Insufficient? I had money! Your system’s messed up!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I apologize Sir. The fee is waived, and I’ll set up alerts to avoid this in the future.
